caption: The drawing depicts a child-like doll figure with pale skin, blue eyes, and long blonde hair styled in curls. The figure is wearing a long-sleeved dress featuring a bold plaid pattern in red, blue, green, and yellow, with prominent dark brown lines and a brown band near the hem and cuffs. The dress has a high neckline adorned with a white lace collar. The doll’s arms are positioned slightly forward and the hands are covered in white gloves. The doll is also wearing white stockings and brown shoes with a small design near the top. The background is plain and uncolored, and the drawing is signed “Edith Downer” in red ink at the bottom right corner.
title: Doll: "Florence"
